name: Verify authorized fulfiller accesses Proactive Assistance on Incident page
objective: Validate that an authorized fulfiller can access and interact with the Proactive Assistance Agent on the Incident page.
precondition: Fulfiller is logged in with authorized role. An incident record exists and is assigned to the fulfiller.

steps.description: Navigate to an assigned Incident record page
steps.expectedResult: Incident page loads with all details

steps.description: Locate and access the Proactive Assistance panel
steps.expectedResult: The Proactive Assistance panel is available and accessible

steps.description: Ask the Agent a question about the incident
steps.expectedResult: The Agent responds within performance expectations with relevant information

steps.description: Verify the response is relevant and accurate
steps.expectedResult: The information returned is relevant to the incident context
